name: Generate images of fMRI
summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a fMRI (task) image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.
description: Runs FSL slicer -a on the input fMRI (task) image and writes raw/out.png. When the volume parameter is set, fslselectvols first extracts that volume from a 4D image; otherwise slicer renders the image as given. Use it for quick visual QA or for figures; it does not modify the data.

inputs.description: The path to the func/task datatype

outputs.description: Directory with out.png, a mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slice montage of the fMRI (task) image.

parameters.description: choose the volume to generate the image of. if empty, will use the first volume
